headline: How do I choose the right garage conversion builder?
articleBody:
Picking the right builder for your garage conversion project in Los Angeles is a huge decision, and it can truly make or break your experience. You're entrusting someone with a significant investment and the transformation of your home, so you want to be sure they're the real deal. It’s not just about getting the cheapest bid; it's about finding a partner who understands your vision and can deliver quality work without unnecessary headaches. 

First off, always verify their credentials. Make sure they are a licensed, insured, and bonded general contractor in California, like Cali View Builders (CSLB #1081371). This protects you from liability and ensures they meet professional standards. Don't be afraid to ask for proof! 

Next, look for experience specifically with garage conversions and ADUs. These projects have unique challenges, especially with Los Angeles's specific zoning and building codes. A builder who's done this before will anticipate issues and streamline the process. 

Communication is key. Do they listen to your ideas? Are they responsive to your questions? A good builder keeps you informed every step of the way and provides clear, detailed scopes of work. You want someone who makes you feel heard and understood. 

Check out their portfolio and references. Seeing their past work can give you a great idea of their quality and style. Also, talking to previous clients can offer insights into their project management and customer service. 

Finally, make sure they align with your project approach. Some builders are strictly construction; others, like Cali View Builders, offer design-build coordination, helping with everything from initial planning and permits to the final walkthrough. This can be a huge benefit for a seamless project.
